newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Vogel & Noot Waermetechnik Q1 pre-tax up.
newsitem.headline: Vogel & Noot Waermetechnik Q1 pre-tax up.

text.p: Austrian heating equipment maker Vogel & Noot Waermetechnik AG said on Monday first quarter pre-tax profit rose to 20 million schillings from three million on sales of 433 million schillings, up from 383 million.
In a statement, Voegel & Noot Waermetechnik said operating profit climbed to 29 million schillings from 12 million.

It traced the improvement to restructuring and cost-cutting at its plant in Lilienthal, Germany, and a positive contribution from fireplace systems. Its VNH joint venture in Poland, begun in May last year, had also yielded a profit.
Vogel & Noot Waermetechnik is majority owned by Vogel & Noot Holding AG. -- Vienna newsroom, +43-1 531 12 254
